identifier_namespace: The Designation of Special Tax Sites (Liverpool City Region, West Midlands and North East Investment Zones) Regulations 2024
evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official GOV.UK page states that West Midlands Investment Zone tax sites are designated and recognised in law as geographical areas, with designation effective from 8 April 2024, and lists Birmingham Knowledge Quarter as one of the two tax sites. The published Birmingham Knowledge Quarter attachment shows the exact tax-site locations. Regulation 3(1)(a) of the Designation of Special Tax Sites (Liverpool City Region, West Midlands and North East Investment Zones) Regulations 2024 designates the areas shown edged and hatched in red on the map entitled 'Birmingham Knowledge Quarter - Tax Site' dated 21 February 2024; the designated areas are known as the 'Birmingham Knowledge Quarter Tax Site'.
binding_method: statutory special-tax-site designation plus legislation-referenced HMRC boundary map and exact legal identifier; vector boundary resolution and canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
